title: শর্তাবলি ও নীতিমালা
content:
1. Enrollment & Admission

  • Admission is confirmed only after full or partial payment of the course fee.
  • Students must provide accurate information during registration. Providing false information may result in disqualification.

2. Fees & Payments

  • Course fees must be paid within the deadlines communicated during admission.
  • Fees are non-refundable once classes have commenced, except under exceptional circumstances at the sole discretion of the management.
  • Any due payments may result in suspension from classes.

3. Course Schedule & Attendance

  • Students are expected to attend all classes regularly and on time.
  • A minimum of 80% attendance is required to be eligible for certification.
  • The institute reserves the right to change class schedules due to unavoidable circumstances.

4. Tools, Uniforms & Property

  • Basic tools and a full chef uniform set are provided free of charge.
  • Students are responsible for maintaining all tools and equipment. Loss or damage may incur replacement charges.

5. Certification

  • Students must pass both theoretical and practical evaluations to receive a certificate.
  • Final certification is provided in collaboration with internationally recognized bodies such as ISO and AQC.

6. Conduct & Behavior

  • Students must maintain respectful behavior with trainers, staff, and fellow students.
  • Any form of harassment, misconduct, or violation of rules may lead to disciplinary action or expulsion.

7. Media & Promotion

  • The institute may use photos or videos taken during classes or events for promotional purposes unless the student notifies otherwise in writing.

8. Changes & Cancellations

  • The institute reserves the right to update course content, timing, fees, or instructors as needed.
  • In case of course cancellation by the institute, enrolled students will be eligible for a full refund or transfer to another batch.

9. Liability

  • The institute is not responsible for personal belongings lost or damaged on the premises.
  • Students are expected to follow all safety protocols. The institute will not be liable for injuries caused by negligence.

10. Agreement

  • By enrolling in any course, the student acknowledges and agrees to abide by all the above terms and conditions.
